PRE-BID CONFERENCE (MANDATORY): A Pre-Bid conference is mandatory and will be held on date a nd time specified in Bid Document. Intending bidder for Pre-Bid meeting shall also furnish name, designati on and contact number to mail id smundv@navy.gov.in of their person attending the Pre-Bid meeting. I n c ase of non-attending the Pre-Bid conference by the firm, firm will be rejected. 2. SERVICE AND SUPPORT: An Registered Office of the service provider must be located at consignee lo cation i.e. in Visakhapatnam. Details for the same along with Registration number on firms letter head is re quired to be submitted along with the bid. 3. The event must be carried out as per SoW attached (It includes printing and installation of banners at the venue as per scheduled date and time). 4. The vendor shall be intimated at least one week prior to the scheduled event. Accordingly, t he vendor shall carry out the necessary site survey and other preparatory activities related to the event well in advance to ensure smooth and timely execution of the event. 4.Income Tax Details. The firm is required to submit Income Tax Return details for last three financial ye ars. 5.Annual Turn Over. The firm is required to submit Annual Turn Over details for last three financial years . 6.Balance sheet & Profit and Loss statement. The balance sheet and profit & loss statement for last t hree financial years duly certified by auditors/ CA is to be submitted. .
